description: This PHP class defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving various time reports within an HRM system. It maps report types to their respective classes and handles the request to serve the appropriate report data based on the request parameters.

classes.name: TimeReportAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing and retrieving different types of time reports, extending functionality from the base ReportAPI class.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the specific report object based on the report name provided in the request. Throws a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
